text: dsh-workbuddy-token 是 DSH 网页端插件，在对话输入框旁放置 WorkBuddy 积分胶囊。它读取 WorkBuddy 凭据并查询积分与模型配置，按当前模型倍率和活动时段折算可用 token 数；界面同时显示积分、倍率和时段信息。支持定时刷新、点击立即刷新，并在上游暂时不可用时展示缓存状态。适合希望在 DSH 中查看 WorkBuddy 余额及大致可用 token 量的用户，需有本机 WorkBuddy 登录凭据。

dsh-workbuddy-token adds a WorkBuddy credit capsule beside the DSH web composer. It reads local credentials, retrieves credits and model rates, and estimates tokens for the current model and promotion period. The capsule refreshes on a schedule or on click, and shows cached data when requests fail.

dsh-workbuddy-token 的功能「积分读取」：插件定时向 WorkBuddy 查询账户剩余积分，并在输入框胶囊中显示余额；点击胶囊可立即刷新积分。
dsh-workbuddy-token 的功能「token 估算」：插件根据当前模型倍率、有效活动时段和剩余积分计算 token 估算；浮动倍率模型显示估算区间。
dsh-workbuddy-token 的功能「状态与缓存」：胶囊显示加载、凭据缺失或失效、正常及缓存过期状态；模型不在 WorkBuddy 目录时只显示积分，不猜测倍率。
dsh-workbuddy-token 使用前须知：需有本机 WorkBuddy 凭据，并连接对应区域服务查询积分和模型配置（见 src/credentials.ts:63-95、src/index.ts:84-99）。

dsh-workbuddy-token README · dsh-workbuddy-token：- 只读:只调 `/v2/billing/meter/get-user-resource` 与 `/v3/config`,不做任何签到/领取/2api 写操作
- 直连上游(`www.codebuddy.cn` / `www.workbuddy.ai`,按凭据 region/domain 路由),不经过 CPA 代理
- 零硬编码数据:模型表、倍率、活动每次刷新全量重建,有效性实时判定
- 请求纪律:积分默认 5 分钟 1 次、配置默认 2 小时 1 次,失败 1→2→4→8 分钟指数退避
- 凭据发现:CPA 目录(`~/.cli-proxy-api/workbuddy-*.json`,glob 发现)→ WorkBuddy 桌面端登录文件;日志与 UI 绝不输出 token

dsh-workbuddy-token README · 配置(profile 插件配置)：| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `creditsIntervalSec` | 300 | 积分刷新间隔(秒,最小 60) |
| `configIntervalSec` | 7200 | 模型/活动配置刷新间隔(秒,最小 600) |
| `cpaDir` | `~/.cli-proxy-api` | CPA 凭据目录 |
| `baseTokensPerCredit` | 50000 | 基准费率:x1 倍率下 1 积分对应的 token 数(2026-10-29 用真实用量实测校准:58.96M token ↔ 201.8 积分,加权倍率 x0.169;官方未公布,后续可再校准) |

自动完成:备份 profile 的 `package.json`/`pnpm-lock.yaml` → 注册 `file:` 依赖并加入 `dsh.profile.bundles` → `pnpm install` → 自检(宿主/客户端模块加载、exports 齐全、凭据发现)。幂等,可重复运行。

dsh-workbuddy-token README · 三态显示：- 正常:实时数据;第二行常驻剩余积分(WorkBuddy 模型附 token 估算);auto 等浮动倍率模型显示区间
- 降级:上游失败时显示最后成功缓存并标注「X 分钟前」
- 异常:凭据失效(401/403)提示重新登录;当前模型已从目录消失显示「已下架」,积分照常;选中的是非 WorkBuddy 模型时不猜倍率、只显示剩余积分

dsh-workbuddy-token README · dsh-workbuddy-token：- Read-only: only calls `/v2/billing/meter/get-user-resource` and `/v3/config`; no check-in, claim, or 2api write endpoints
- Connects directly to the WorkBuddy upstream (`www.codebuddy.cn` / `www.workbuddy.ai`, routed by the credential's region/domain) — CPA is not a dependency and is never modified
- Zero hardcoded data: model roster, multipliers and promotions are rebuilt from the upstream on every refresh; validity is judged at compute time
- Request discipline: credits every 5 minutes and config every 2 hours by default, exponential backoff (1→2→4→8 min) on failure
- Credential discovery: CPA directory (`~/.cli-proxy-api/workbuddy-*.json`, glob) → WorkBuddy desktop sign-in file; neither logs nor UI ever print tokens

dsh-workbuddy-token README · Install into a DSH Desktop profile：```bash
pnpm i && pnpm build
node install.mjs                 # desktop profile by default; --profile <name> for others
```

The installer automatically: backs up the profile's `package.json`/`pnpm-lock.yaml` → registers the `file:` dependency and adds the package to `dsh.profile.bundles` → runs `pnpm install` → self-checks (host/client module loading, exports completeness, credential discovery). Idempotent; safe to re-run.

dsh-workbuddy-token README · Three display states：- Normal: live data; remaining credits stay on the second line (WorkBuddy models add the token estimate); floating-rate models (e.g. `auto`) show a range
- Stale: on upstream failure, shows the last successful cache labeled "X min ago"
- Error: rejected credentials (401/403) prompt re-login; a model that vanished from the roster shows "delisted" while credits stay live; a model that never belonged to the WorkBuddy roster shows credits only, with no guessed rate
